description: Address code review issues: remove doubled payload, add prompt injection protection, fix server-side evidence level validation, fix frontend evidence level mismatch, fix FCA keyword false-positives, add filename sanitization, and add server-side request body size check.
steps: STEP 1 - Fix doubled payload in index.html handleChartUpload
STEP 2 - Add prompt injection sanitization in api/analyze.js buildDocumentContext
STEP 3 - Always recalculate evidence level server-side in api/analyze.js
STEP 4 - Fix frontend getEvidenceLevel to only count extractable documents
STEP 5 - Fix FCA keyword false-positives with word boundary regex
STEP 6 - Add filename sanitization in api/analyze.js handleChartUpload
STEP 7 - Add server-side document count validation in api/analyze.js
acceptance_criteria: image field is null when images array is non-empty
Document text is sanitized before prompt inclusion
Frontend only counts TXT/CSV as documents for evidence level
FCA detection uses word boundary regex
Filenames are sanitized before inclusion in prompts
All JS files pass node -c syntax check
